name: Arity-3 H-box as phase gadgets
summary: An arity-3 H-box with label $e^{iα}$ decomposes into phases ±α/4 on all non-empty parities of its legs.
description:
An arity-3 H-box with label $e^{i\alpha}$ applies the phase $e^{i\alpha xyz}$. Using the identity $4xyz = x + y + z - x\oplus y - x\oplus z - y\oplus z + x\oplus y\oplus z$ this can be written with a Z-phase $\frac{\alpha}{4}$ on each leg, phase gadgets with phase $-\frac{\alpha}{4}$ on each pair of legs, and a phase gadget with phase $\frac{\alpha}{4}$ on all three legs.

With $\alpha = \pi$ this is the well-known decomposition of the CCZ gate into seven T-like phases. In general, an H-box with $n$ legs decomposes in this way into $2^n - 1$ phase gadgets with phases $\pm\frac{\alpha}{2^{n-1}}$.
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
